{{Quote|I am Seetoo Enntoo, steward of this vessel. It is my extreme good fortune to serve you.|C2-N2|<ref name="TOR:IC" />}}
'''C2-N2''', also known as '''Seetoo Enntoo''', was a [[Hollis-series steward droid]] owned by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] known as the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]]. Assigned to the [[The Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette|Jedi's ''Defender''-class light corvette]] as its steward in [[3643 BBY]], C2-N2 was responsible for maintaining the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and ensuring that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] crew remained comfortable.
